sn46.6:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sākete viharati añjanavane migadāye.
sn46.6:1.2: atha kho kuṇḍaliyo paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn46.6:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kuṇḍaliyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn46.6:1.5: tassa mayhaṃ bho gotama pacchābhattaṃ bhuttapātarāsassa ayamāhāro hoti
sn46.6:1.6: ārāmena ārāmaṃ uyyāyena uyyānaṃ anucaṅkamāmi anuvicarāmi
sn46.6:1.7: so tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe iti vādappamokkhānisaṃsaṃ ceva kathaṃ kathente upārambhānisaṃsaṃ ca
sn46.6:2.1: katame pana bho gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.2: satta kho kuṇḍaliya bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.3: katame pana bho gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.4: cattāro kho kuṇḍaliya satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.5: katame pana bho gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.6: tīṇi kho kuṇḍaliya sucaritāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.7: katame pana bho gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tīṇi sucaritāni paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:2.8: indriyasaṃvaro kho kuṇḍaliya bhāvito bahulīkato tīṇi sucaritāni paripūreti.
sn46.6:3.1: kathaṃ bhāvito kuṇḍaliya indriyasaṃvaro kathaṃ bahulīkato tīṇi sucaritāni paripūreti.
sn46.6:3.2: idha kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpaṃ nābhijjhāyati nāvihiṃsati na rāgaṃ janeti
sn46.6:3.3: tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
sn46.6:3.4: cakkhunā kho paneva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto ādinnamānaso abyāpannacetaso
sn46.6:3.5: tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
sn46.6:4.1: puna caparaṃ kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe…
sn46.6:4.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpaṃ nābhijjhāyati nāvihiṃsati na rāgaṃ janeti
sn46.6:4.6: tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
sn46.6:4.7: manasā kho paneva dhammaṃ viññāya amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto ādinnamānaso abyāpannacetaso
sn46.6:4.8: tassa ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
sn46.6:5.1: yato kho kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpāmanāpesu rūpesu ṭhito ādinnamānaso abyāpannacetaso tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
sn46.6:5.6: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpāmanāpesu dhammesu ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
sn46.6:5.7: evambhāvito kho kuṇḍaliya indriyasaṃvaro evaṃ bahulīkato tīṇi sucaritāni paripūreti.
sn46.6:6.1: kathaṃ bhāvitāni tāni ca kuṇḍaliya tīṇi sucaritāni kathaṃ bahulīkatāni cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrenti.
sn46.6:6.2: idha kuṇḍaliya bhikkhaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ pahānāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti vacīduccaritaṃ pahānāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti manoduccaritaṃ pahānāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti.
sn46.6:6.3: evaṃ bhāvitāni kho kuṇḍaliya tīṇi sucaritāni evaṃ bahulīkatāni cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrenti.
sn46.6:7.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca kuṇḍaliya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā kathaṃ bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrenti.
sn46.6:7.2: idha kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
sn46.6:7.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn46.6:7.6: evaṃ bhāvitā kho kuṇḍaliya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā evaṃ bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrenti.
sn46.6:8.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca kuṇḍaliya satta bojjhaṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrenti.
sn46.6:8.2: idha kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ …pe…
sn46.6:8.3: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.6:8.4: evaṃ bhāvitā kho kuṇḍaliya satta bojjhaṅgā evaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrentīti.
sn46.6:9.1: evaṃ vutte kuṇḍaliyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn46.6:9.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
sn46.6:9.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evameva kho bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
sn46.6:9.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn46.6:9.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
